##### Project general facts

Al Furjan by Nakheel is a vibrant residential community offering spacious 4-bedroom villas and 3-bedroom townhouses designed for comfortable and modern family living. The residences combine contemporary architecture with thoughtfully planned layouts and private outdoor spaces, creating an ideal balance of privacy, comfort, and functionality. Each home features a private garden, covered parking for two cars, en-suite bathrooms in all bedrooms, fitted wardrobes, and a dedicated service staff room.

The community offers a well-rounded lifestyle surrounded by landscaped green spaces, parks, shopping destinations, and sports facilities. A peaceful lake and beautifully maintained gardens create a pleasant environment for outdoor activities and relaxation, while the convenient infrastructure provides easy access to everyday essentials. Residents can also benefit from nearby schools, nurseries, medical centres, pharmacies, supermarkets, cafés, and restaurants.

The residences are equipped with premium appliances and feature modern technologies, including Smart Home adaptations and electric vehicle charging ports. Outdoor terraces overlook the landscaped gardens and pools, extending the living spaces into the open air. High-quality materials and contemporary features throughout the homes create a refined and practical environment designed for modern family life.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is a residential community situated in close proximity to Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), and other popular areas in Dubai. It covers an area of approximately 560 hectares and consists of both villas and apartment buildings, offering a diverse range of housing options for residents.

The community is known for its well-planned infrastructure and thoughtfully designed properties. It features a mix of architectural styles, including Arabic, Mediterranean, and contemporary designs, creating a visually appealing and diverse atmosphere.

In terms of amenities, Al Furjan offers a range of facilities to enhance the quality of life for its residents. These include landscaped parks, playgrounds, fitness centers, swimming pools, sports courts, and cycling and jogging tracks. There are also retail centers within the community that provide convenient access to shopping, dining, and other essential services.
